name: pm-feature-request-triage
description: Sorts a week of incoming feature requests into a triage board with a request log, the job behind each request, a build / later / no sort and a reply draft for every requester. Use for "run pm-feature-request-triage", "triage feature requests", "sales promised a feature", "a big client wants this", "the CEO forwarded a request", "sort this week's requests", "how do I say no to a feature request", "feature request intake", part of the AI for Product Management Pack by 90n.
